Outlier is a first of its kind sports betting research & data app for smarter, more profitable, and more efficient bettors. Try Outlier free for 7 days, then keep going with an Outlier subscription*.

Join the THOUSANDS OF NEW USERS EACH MONTH improving their outcomes by leveraging Outlier’s deep stats and insights. 

Effortlessly visualize and filter all of the supporting stats, matchups, injuries and more to make the best picks.

Outlier has all the leagues, all the props, all the betting markets, all the statistics, and all the odds. Current coverage (May 2026)

- NBA
- NFL
- NHL
- NCAA Basketball
- NCAA Football
- MLB
- WNBA
- Soccer (EPL, Bundesliga, La Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS, and more coming soon)

You’ll also have access to LIVE SUPPORT and the Outlier Discord Community if you ever have questions or need guidance on our tools.

Here are some of the key features you’ll have access to with your Outlier subscription

- Trending Insights: Browse and tail trending picks and parlays;
- Supporting Stats: Easily understand how a player has performed against particular prop lines based on minutes played, scoring composition, fouls, offensive stats, defensive stats, and more.
- Player-Specific Insights: Understand how specific players perform on the road, after a loss, against a particular team, against a power-ranked defense, without a key teammate, and more;
- Line Movement Tracker: Analyze how the odds have shifted since being publicly released and which side the public is betting on;
- Custom Filters and Real Time Notifications;
- Injury Reports: See who's starting, who's sitting, and how lineup changes are anticipated to affect gamelines and player props;
- Share Betslip: Share your betslip with friends, followers, and subscribers, allowing them to tail your picks in just two clicks;
- Real Time Odds Movement Charts; (Outlier Premium+ and Pro Only)
- Positive EV: Browse a live feed of EV+ plays, filtered to your strategy; (Outlier Pro Only)
- Sharp Book Odds: Choose which sportsbook you prefer to interpret fair odds with; (Outlier Pro Only)
- Arbitrage: Thousands of lines analyzed in real-time to find you guaranteed win opportunities; (Outlier Pro Only)
- Middle Betting: Low risk, high reward arbitrage events in an easy to execute interface; (Outlier Pro Only)
- Boosts: Access a feed of boosted odds paired with expected value analysis. (Outlier Pro Only)

We strive to release new feature requests and optimizations on a weekly basis. Have ideas for something you’d like to see? Send us a note!

We're so confident that Outlier will improve your betting strategy, we are giving users full access to try it out, risk free. Find your next bet on Outlier today.

ABOUT US
The team behind Outlier is a small group of sports fans and engineers. Our mission is to create smarter, more confident and more enjoyable betting experiences. We don’t earn revenue from sports books or affiliates, only from constantly satisfied customers.

DISCLOSURE

All information and gambling related content is for informational and entertainment purposes only and is not gambling or financial advice. Outlier is not a sportsbook and does not accept wagers or real-money deposits.

*Outlier is a subscription service that has three tiers. Premium costs $19.99/month or $199.99/year, Premium+ costs $29.99/month or $299.99/year, Pro costs $79.99/month or $359.99/year (prices vary by region). Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
